headline: Lebanon Cuts Power to Public Bodies Amid Deepening Energy Crisis
summary: Lebanon has cut electricity supplies to public bodies as political disputes and war worsen the national power crisis, with experts urging deeper reforms.
why: Severe infrastructure degradation and power cuts cripple domestic economic operations and increase fiscal strain in Lebanon.

impacts.name: Lebanon
impacts.why: Electricity shutoffs severely impair government operations and economic output.
